name: Predazzo (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of light blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Predazzo (a black swallow above waves, with keys) in a yellow baroque cartouche.
history: Municipal flag of Predazzo, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Predazzo arms — swallow above waves and keys, crowned, in a yellow cartouche
baroque cartouche and crown around the arms
